purpose: Analysis rules saved after primary execution began but before inspection of held-out score outcomes; not externally preregistered
primary_unit: Independent procedural world; average repeated paired seeds within world
primary_population: All 48 frozen V5 test worlds, 2 repetitions per core method
score_population: Jointly admitted matched world/repetition pairs only; report all other admission categories separately
score_effect: 100*(baselineQ-V5Q)/baselineQ, averaged within world then across worlds
uncertainty: 5000 whole-world percentile bootstrap samples, seed 6104, descriptive 95% intervals
tests: Exploratory two-sided sign-flip permutation tests on world-mean score differences, 100000 Monte Carlo samples, seed 7421, plus-one correction; Holm adjustment across the three primary V5 contrasts
secondary: Admission, planning runtime, actual metric calls, feature removal, shorter budgets, 80 candidate ceiling, execution outcomes and work are reported separately
subgroups: All four map families; no selecting only favorable maps or replacing test cases
physics: Scheduled-denominator success and executed-denominator success both reported; failures retained; assistance 0.5 is velocity blending rather than a halving of physical force or energy
limits: Restricted simulator, related baselines, eight-world development search, nominal battery, no hardware, no claim of universal superiority; inference conditional on jointly admitted worlds
timing_note: First saved 2026-10-29 02:37:05 UTC; primary started 02:36:20 UTC. Original purpose incorrectly described development as still running. Only this timing description was corrected; analysis rules remain unchanged.
